components.role: Late copy head: reads a prompt token (the user's guess) and writes its own identity toward the answer; this copying is much stronger in A (copy z +2.7, output-weighted +3.0; the value-matrix change agrees)
Late guess-copying head, strengthened in A (copy z +1.7, output-weighted +2.7)
Final-layer head: copy-suppression-like in both models, suppresses less / copies the guess more in A (z +2.3); part of the final-layer change in which source token is read
Late guess-copying head, more copy and sharper attention in A (z +2.2)
Final-layer head: more copying in A (z +2.1) and the largest attention-target change in layer 17, onto one source-token feature
Global-attention head with the largest attention-target change in the network (3.3x median); in B it moves more question-derived internal features to the answer position (correct-answer pathway)
Answer-position MLP after the copy heads: in A it amplifies the token direction it reads (the copied guess); self-copy change z +3.0 for the output matrix and +1.5 for the input matrix
Mid-layer head that in B moves more internal (MLP-built) question features to the answer position for recall; weakened in the sycophantic model
Answer-position units retuned most between the models; their outputs feed the queries/keys of the layer 12 and 15-17 heads, switching between answering from the guess and from knowledge
Strongest single-unit retuning at the answer position; feeds the queries of layer 11 head 0 and layer 16 head 0 (what the answer position looks for)

prediction.evidence: D = A - B acts like ± the gradient of (logit of the guess - logit of the true answer); with tied embeddings only the sycophant gains copy-from-prompt structure. A per-head sign test on diag(dW_O*W_V) (calibrated null N(0.1,1.05), off-diagonal controls ~0) shows all 8 layer-16/17 heads copy more in A (combined z ~+5.7), strongest (z ~5) in embedding-dominated dimensions, i.e. copying the guess's own identity. Independently confirmed by the layer-16/17 value-matrix change (z +2.4 in those dimensions) and by the layer-16 MLP amplifying the copied token in A (z +3.0). B's extra copying (L10h0/h1/h3, L11h0) lies only in non-output, MLP-feature dimensions (moving question content); no layer shows B writing copied prompt tokens into the output. Copy-suppression heads suppress less in A (weak). Largest attention-target changes: L11h0/h1 and the layer-17 heads. Strongest retuned MLP units: L7 u186/u256 and L11 u1631/u15/u892/u743/u137/u818.
